method: Installed image tool motif; white paper removed in memory, earth pigment area-averaged into vacant rock.
visual_review: Final PNG and decoded 512px JPEG inspected. Pepe retains a broad mouth and heavy-lidded eyes. Both inherited hands counted: four fingers plus one opposing thumb each, five digits. No new hands or stencils. No writing, numerals, captions, signature, logo, watermark, border, frame, people, political or hateful symbol observed.
limitations: Inherited rock has a photographic-looking texture; preserved as required.
New pigment is small and subdued at thumbnail scale.
Visual review is local, not independent artistic certification.
meaning: Two witnesses shelter one ember before passing its warmth onward.
